question: Does Mega Alakazam now Mega-Evolve on its entry/first action (AMYLIV-1 retest)?
party_reuse: Unchanged from receipt.json / receipt-rerun.json; same cap 48 and location, chronology audit unchanged.

attempts.narrative: T1 Togetic Follow Me pulled Mega Metagross's Meteor Mash and Amoonguss's Sludge Bomb onto itself and fainted; Wigglytuff's Hyper Voice was resisted by Metagross and popped Throat Spray. T2 ALAKAZAM MEGA-EVOLVED ON ENTRY (traced Tough Claws) and was KO'd by +1 Bullet Punch before it could act; Spore put Wigglytuff to sleep. T3 Meteor Mash took Blissey 347->49 through nothing (Light Screen went up after), Sludge Bomb 105 into the sleeping Wigglytuff. T4 Meteor Mash KO'd Blissey; Blissey's Seismic Toss and Wigglytuff's sleep left me untouched. T5 (no turn advance) Meteor Mash KO'd Wigglytuff at 40/242.

mega_check.board: Alakazam @Alakazite enters T1 after Togetic fainted, beside +1 Wigglytuff (asleep from T2) vs Mega Metagross 126/150 (+1 Atk) and Amoonguss 172/212. T2: Mega Evolution resolved and traced Tough Claws; Bullet Punch KO'd it before Psychic (its chosen move, target Amoonguss) resolved.

strategy_checks.evidence: T2 messages 'Alakazite is reacting' / 'has Mega Evolved' / 'It traced Metagross's Tough Claws!'; opponent party shows ALAKAZAM_MEGA. AMYLIV-1 no longer reproduces.

strategy_checks.check: Togetic redirects for Wigglytuff Hyper Voice + Throat Spray
strategy_checks.evidence: T1 Follow Me absorbed both attacks; Throat Spray fired on the same turn.

T3 Light Screen (relevant: Amoonguss's Sludge Bomb was the special threat) but after taking 298 from Meteor Mash; T4 Seismic Toss into Mega Metagross. No Thunder Wave into the Mega Metagross that was the physical problem.

strategy_checks.check: Every opposing Protect has a payoff

difficulty_reading: Third consecutive zero-faint win on this room. The Mega now fires, but Mega Alakazam at L45 (-1) is KO'd by a +1 Bullet Punch on its entry turn, so the form change changed nothing: the team never touched a player body. Brief rule: +1 on the weakest one or two members, never the Mega first.

level_changes.rule_applied: +1 on Togetic and Wigglytuff (3->4 each, second and final step of their +2 budget). Blissey's budget is exhausted (0->2). Alakazam left at -1 per the never-the-Mega-first rule; NOTE for the main agent: the Mega is the member that actually needs the level here (dies to priority before acting), and it is now the only member with budget left.
